definition: A phrase or clause functioning as the predicate of a nominal/copy/negative-predicate construction.
traditional_teaching_mapping: Distinguish Khabar of nominal sentence, Khabar Kana, and related negative predicate contexts.
frequency_and_mapping_caveat: Phrase external function; word-level PRED role is not automatically the same measure.

definition: A phrase/clause functioning as agent or subject of an action.
traditional_teaching_mapping: Map to Fa‘il where the source analysis supports that equivalence.
frequency_and_mapping_caveat: Do not infer function from a single word annotation if span is larger.

definition: A phrase/clause serving as the passive subject/deputy agent.
traditional_teaching_mapping: Map to Na’ib Fa‘il where verified.
frequency_and_mapping_caveat: Keep passive clause structure distinct from the phrase type.

definition: A phrase/clause functioning as Hal, describing state/circumstance.
traditional_teaching_mapping: May be an Ism, PP, or clause; preserve structure and role separately.
frequency_and_mapping_caveat: Not every phrase with a locative/temporal meaning is a Hal.

definition: A phrase or clause modifying a noun as a descriptive attribute.
traditional_teaching_mapping: Can be a single adjective, phrase or relative clause depending on analysis.
frequency_and_mapping_caveat: Do not collapse it into the descriptive six-pattern phrase; one is construction, one external function.

definition: A phrase functioning as a genitive/annexation complement.
traditional_teaching_mapping: Internal Mudaf/Mudaf Ilayh structure and external role are separate dimensions.
frequency_and_mapping_caveat: Do not count each member word as an independent phrase.

definition: A clause/span functioning as the result of a conditional clause.
traditional_teaching_mapping: Keep condition and result as distinct clause spans where possible, linked by condition-result relation.
frequency_and_mapping_caveat: An enclosing conditional construction may include both child clauses.

definition: Broad dependency function including apposition, emphasis, exception and coordination.
traditional_teaching_mapping: Retain subfunction: Badal, Tawkid, exception, conjunction and other dependency relations.
frequency_and_mapping_caveat: Source category may need subfunction crosswalk before learner-facing grouping.
